title: Design > Components
captureState: Seeded fixture; Design > Components; Fin set selected after the seeded fin-span edit (proposal shown against the previous revision); thread 'Fin revision' with its canned exchange.
source: concepts.md §3, §4.2; spec B1; plan D10 (U8, U10); BC0 critic (M1.15b)

items.text: Header bar across the top, about 56 px tall, flat, with a 1 px hairline below.
Rocket mark and the wordmark 'RocketWright' (the product name, not the art's name).
Project switcher showing the loaded project name ('Research vehicle') with a ▾ menu.
Save state with a cloud icon and a relative time computed from the real last save ('Saved … ago').
Centred tabs Design | Propulsion | Simulate | Results.
Design is the active tab, marked by a 2 px teal underline.
'✓ Check model' primary button: deep teal fill, 1 px teal border, white text; its state reflects the real model check result (status, issue count).
Settings gear button opening minimal settings.
Help '?' button.
Left rail, about 17% of the width, threads group above the page navigation section, hairline divider on its right.

items.source: C§3 Left rail, threads group; S:169 seeded threads
items.text: Thread rows with icon, name, and relative age: Assembly review, Fin revision, Flight comparison (seeded).
The selected thread row is highlighted.
'+ New thread' row below the threads.
Titled navigation section 'Components' with a search icon and '+'.
Workspace column, about 58% of the width, between the rail and the agent pane.
Docked agent pane, about 25% of the width, full height below the header, hairline divider on its left (not a floating dock).
Pane head rendered by RocketWright above the embedded chat: thread icon and the open thread's title 'Fin revision', the same thread the left rail highlights.

items.source: C§3 Agent pane; S:169 allowed deviation; U17; D10; D31
items.text: 'Agent' settings button in the pane head that opens the agent's provider and model settings (the S:169 'Agent ▾' mapping).

items.source: C§3 Agent pane; C§2 bubble/user; D31
items.text: The user's message in a teal-tinted bubble, radius about 6 px, with the round user avatar beside it.
An `rw:` app reference in the thread renders as a chip naming the entity, not as raw text; it resolves to a stable entity id and opens that entity in RocketWright.
App tool rows for the turn's tool calls: a leading chevron that expands the call, a tool icon, the tool's label in sans, and a teal success check.
Agent reply after the turn's tool rows and cards, written as plain prose with no bubble, under the agent's name.
Composer pinned to the bottom of the agent pane.
Composer placeholder 'Ask about this design…'.
Paperclip attach button.
Send button.
Bottom-right footer of the agent pane states the provenance of the data shown (it replaces the art's placeholder footer).
Design history strip along the bottom of the rail and workspace.

items.source: C§3 Design history strip; C§6 (02); D10
items.text: Label 'Design history', then numbered step circles joined by hairlines, each with a name and date; numbers are sequential and unique, from the seeded history.
The current step has a teal ring.
'Compare' button at the end of the strip.
'⋯' menu after Compare.
Design local tabs Assembly | Components | Configurations, with Components active.
Components tree rows from the fixture, with a single 'Fin set' row for the whole fin set.
Fin set row selected with the teal tint and edge.
Eye toggle on each tree row.
Rendered part thumbnail on each tree row.
Left rail footer holding the view chips.
View chips Side | Top | Front | Rear in the left rail footer, Side active.
2D view in the upper ~60% of the workspace.
Side orthographic view (X-Z), nose to the left: dark nose, satin airframe with joint lines, metal tail.
CG marker: teal-ringed dot labelled 'CG' with its station in mm, computed from the model.
CP marker: crosshair circle labelled 'CP' with its station in mm, computed from the model.
For the stable fixture, CG sits forward of (left of) CP.
Dimension lines nose-to-CG, CG-to-CP, and overall length, with mm values from the model.
Proposed fin set drawn in teal fill with a teal label 'New fin (span …)'; the fill marks every fin of the set alike, and the drawn fin count matches Fin count.
Previous fin geometry as a dashed amber outline labelled 'Previous fin (span …)'.
Bottom labels 'Side view (X-Z)' and 'Scale: 1:N'.
Orientation thumbnail cube with axis labels.
'Fin set' editor in the lower ~40% of the workspace, collapsible (chevron).
Editor tabs Geometry | Material | Appearance | Mass override, Geometry active.
Two columns of spinner fields with units: Root chord, Tip chord, Span, Sweep, Thickness, Fin count; values from the model.
Live 'Fin profile (side view)' preview dimensioned with tip chord, root chord, and span from the fields.
Amber status '● Modified · Simulation needs rerun'.
'Parts library' button (presets from the Apache openrocket-database only).
'Revert change' button that steps back to the previous revision.

items.source: C§4.2 Agent pane; C§5.4; D10 U8; D31
items.text: 'Changed fields' card in the strip between the pane head and the embedded chat, listing each edited parameter as old → new with units, from the revision diff or the unsaved edit.

items.source: C§4.2 Agent pane; U13; D8; D31
items.text: 'Compare revisions ›' action on the Changed fields card (a step card's Compare action in the thread opens the same comparison).

items.source: C§4.2 Agent pane; C§6 (05) one owner; D10 U8; D31
items.text: Thread history: the left rail lists the project's threads with their ages, the open thread highlighted; this thread's own revisions, with name and time and the current one on a teal ring, sit in the strip between the pane head and the embedded chat and link to their history steps.
Faint background grid behind the 2D side view, over the viewport's vertical vignette (the grid is suppressed only on the Assembly page).
Every fin of a set renders with identical geometry and size, and the selection fill covers the whole set.
Editing a geometry field updates the 2D view, the ghost outline, the fin profile preview, and CG/CP live.
Mass override tab exposes mass and CG-override fields that replace the derived values when set.
Spinner fields take units, limits, and defaults from the component-type parameter schema and reject out-of-range values.
The editor's active tab is remembered and restored when a component is reselected.

items.source: C§4.2 Notes; C§6 missing everywhere; BC0 critic
items.text: Multi-select of components edits shared parameters; a mixed-type selection shows only the Appearance tab.
Stability margin in calibers derived from CG/CP, shown with the markers and recomputed on each edit.
Undo/redo for design edits, so an edit can be undone as well as reverted.
